title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.156 QA: reframes the first Character Sheet tab as Biography instead of a duplicate mechanics dashboard. Biography now focuses on Backstory, Notes, Conditions, and streamlined Initiative. Quick Dice Pool moves to Skills. Player initiative is reduced to choosing Cool or Vigilance and rolling; encounter start/tracker/reset controls remain GM-only. The header quick-info area is now two full-width rows: Characteristics, then Health & Defense. Preserves five-pip Skills, Talent Tier lanes, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
